note: Firestore does not return HTTP 429. It returns gRPC RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED (code 8) and ABORTED (code 10). The message string distinguishes the conditions.

per_user_quota.fix: wait until midnight Pacific, or enable billing

ramp_up_limit.fix: exponential backoff; clears in seconds to minutes as Firestore repartitions

ABORTED.meaning: too much contention on the same document or transaction
causes: a document receiving too many updates per second (sustained above ~1 write/sec)
overlapping transactions on the same documents
rapid traffic increases that outpace load-based splitting or encounter hot-spots
ABORTED.fix: reduce per-document write rate, not overall volume

causes: un-indexed field value > 1,048,487 bytes (1 MiB - 89 bytes)

DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.meaning: operation took longer than the 60-second default deadline
DEADLINE_EXCEEDED.fix: break the operation into smaller chunks or increase the deadline

hot_spots.sequential_ids: all writes hit one key range → hot-spot, prevents scaling
hot_spots.single_counter_document: every increment hits one document → ABORTED at ~1 write/sec

retry_guidance.primary_fix: parse the error message string, not the gRPC code
retry_guidance.daily_quota: do not retry; alert and wait for midnight Pacific or enable billing
retry_guidance.ramp_up: exponential backoff with jitter; clears in seconds to minutes
retry_guidance.aborted: reduce write rate to the specific document; retry with jitter

escape_hatch: distribute key space with random IDs before you need to; shard counters; keep per-document writes under ~1/sec
